extraction_quality_notes: Ranking observations were limited to presentation features and diagnostic workup available before endovascular intervention.
No paper disease-label field or paper-title-derived diagnostic evidence is included.
Disease-specific ordinary observed axes were avoided; vascular findings are represented as generic imaging, angiography, ultrasound, hemodynamic, and vital-sign axes.

PMC browser HTML was blocked; NCBI EFetch XML for this PMCID exposed identifiers and abstract but not the full case-presentation body, so the publisher full-text HTML was used for the rankable case details.

No exact heart rate, temperature, oxygen saturation, respiratory rate, serum creatinine, BUN, eGFR, urinalysis, renin/aldosterone, troponin, D-dimer, CRP, ESR, CBC, or abdominal pain findings are reported in the case-presentation snapshot.
